d:
Seth addresses President Trump posting on social media about his personal tax returns and Republicans losing in the midterms and more in his monologue for Thursday, November 12, before taking a closer look at Democrats notching another huge victory by flipping a Senate seat in Mississippi and House Democrats expressing frustration at their colleagues who missed a vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
Watch Late Night with Seth Meyers Weeknights 12:35ET/11:35c on NBC.
